intro: Welcome to the Rope Isles! Every islet is a stall and every bridge is a street.
Fruit, rope, reeds and sailcloth. Merge two of a kind and the traders will pay.
I'm looking for a man with a cigar and a skiff.
Half the market is. Help me open my stall first.

tasks.title: Raise the rope stall
dialogue: The tide took my stall. Three times this year.
Kiki repeats everything. Don't tell her secrets.

tasks.title: Hang the trading scales
dialogue: Marek, sailmaker. You must be the café girl everyone talks about.
Nell. Everyone seems to know me before I arrive.

tasks.title: Stretch a sail awning
dialogue: My sails keep the sun off the fruit. Fair trade for a few skewers.
He means free fruit. He always means free fruit.

tasks.title: Find Rafe's skiff
dialogue: She smelled it near the north islet. There's a skiff tied under the mangroves.
It's his. The seat still smells of smoke.

tasks.title: Repair the net-mender's hut
dialogue: ...You followed me all the way here.
I ran from whoever set that fire. They know I saw them.

tasks.title: Open the Rope Market
dialogue: The market is open! Every bridge full of traders.
If I talk, I need the council to protect me.
Then come back with me and talk.

tasks.title: Build the trading dock
dialogue: Ships from every island again. I've never sold so many sails.
And oil. Somebody's buying a lot of lamp oil.

tasks.title: Check the oil ledger
dialogue: Twenty barrels, the week before the fire. Signed 'S.'
S... Silas. The lamp trader from Moon Grove.
Ada smelled lamp oil that night.

tasks.title: Open the sail loft
dialogue: Silas bought rope too. Rope soaked in oil burns fast.

tasks.title: Bring Rafe to the council
dialogue: I'll say it in front of everyone. I saw Silas on the café pier, with a lamp.
The council heard you. Silas will be called.

tasks.title: Restring every bridge
dialogue: Every islet joined again. Like the archipelago.
Six islands. One left to bring back.

tasks.title: Hold the Kite Festival
dialogue: A kite for every island! Look at them over the water.
Silas went home to Moon Grove. Nobody goes there at night.
Then I'll go at night. Next, Moon Grove.
